rows.source: A’a, uh, a’a, na jira ɗaya ne - wannan mummunan abu ne na alamar rashin gaskiya - mafi munin alamar rashin gaskiya da ban taɓa gani ba.”
rows.output: “Uh, no, I’m waiting for one - this is a really bad sign of dishonesty - the worst sign of dishonesty I’ve ever seen.”
rows.reference: No, uh no, I wait one - that was really bad body language - the worst body language I've ever seen."

rows.source: Yanzu Labour ba wani babban majami’a ne ba.
rows.output: Now, Labour is no longer a major party.
rows.reference: Labour is no longer a broad church.

rows.source: Wani rashin haƙuri ne na waɗanda ke faɗan abin da ke cikin zuciyarsu
rows.output: It is a lack of tolerance of those who speak of what is in their hearts.
rows.reference: It is intolerant of those who speak their minds

rows.source: A lokacin da ‘yan rajin Momentum a cikin jam’iyyata ta gida suka jefa kuri’a don tsaida ni, ba wani abin mamaki ne ba.
rows.output: When the Momentum rebels within my own party voted to censure me, it was not a surprise.
rows.reference: When Momentum's activists in my local party voted to censure me, it was hardly a surprise.

rows.source: Tun da yake, ni ne mafi sabo a wani layi na mambobin Labour na majalisa da za a faɗa musu ba a maraba da mu - dukka saboda faɗan abi da ke zuciyarmu.
rows.output: However, I am the most recent in a line of Labour members of parliament to be welcomed - all because of the legacy of the left in our hearts.
rows.reference: After all, I'm the latest in a line of Labour MPs to be told we are not welcome - all for speaking our minds.

rows.source: Abokiyata a majalisa Joan Ryan ta sami irin wulakanci saboda ta tsaya tsayin daka tana faɗa da ra’ayin ƙin Yahudawa.
rows.output: My colleague in the House of Commons, Joan Ryan, has faced similar abuse for standing up and speaking out against anti-Semitism.
rows.reference: My parliamentary colleague Joan Ryan received similar treatment because she resolutely stood up to antisemitism.

rows.source: A nawa misalin, batun dakatarwar ya soke ni don ƙin yarda da Jeremy Corbyn.
rows.output: For example, the issue of the suspension was canceled for me because of my refusal to agree with Jeremy Corbyn.
rows.reference: In my case, the censure motion criticised me for disagreeing with Jeremy Corbyn.

rows.source: A kan amfani na wani ƙudurin tattalin arzikin mai kyau, a kan tsaron ƙasa, a kan Turai, abin takaici batutuwa iri guda wanda a kai Jeremy ya ƙi yarda da shugabanni da suka wuce.
rows.output: On the use of a good economic program, on national security, on Europe, the same issues that Jeremy refused to accept from previous leaders.
rows.reference: On the importance of a responsible economic policy, on national security, on Europe, ironically similar issues on which Jeremy disagreed with previous leaders.

rows.source: Sanarwa don taron Labour ta Nottingham ta Gabas a ranar Juma’a ta kawo cewa, “muna son tarukan su zama a haɗe da  ma’ana.”
rows.output: Announcement for the Nottingham East Labour Party meeting on Friday stated, "we want the meetings to be held in conjunction with the meaning."
rows.reference: The notice for the Nottingham East Labour meeting on Friday stated that "we want the meetings to be inclusive and productive."

rows.source: Ga mafi yawan na shekaru takwas ɗin a matsayi na mamban Labour a majalisa, haka dai yake daren tarukan GC.
rows.output: For most of the past eight years, I have been a member of the Labour Party in the House, and that is how it has been on the night of the GC meetings.
rows.reference: For most of my eight years as the local Labour MP, the Friday night GC meetings have been exactly that.

rows.source: Abin takaici a yau, ba shi ne fasalin taruka da yawa kuma alkawari na siyasa ta “ihsani, hankali” tuni aka manta idan, ma, an taɓa farawa.
rows.output: Unfortunately, today is not a day of many meetings and political promises of "light, reason" have already been forgotten if, indeed, they were ever made.
rows.reference: Sadly today, it is not the tone of many meetings and the promise of "kinder, gentler" politics has long been forgotten if, indeed, it ever began.

rows.source: Yana ƙara zama a bayyane fili cewa ba a haƙuri da ra’ayoyi daban-daban a cikin jam’iyyar Labour kuma ana hukunta kowane ra’ayi a kan ko zai karɓu ga shugabannin jam’iyyar.
rows.output: It is becoming increasingly clear that there is no tolerance for different views within the Labour Party and that any dissenting view is being punished for whether it will be accepted by the party leaders.
rows.reference: It has become increasingly apparent that differing views are not tolerated in the Labour party and every opinion is judged on whether it is acceptable to the party leadership.

rows.source: Wannan ya fara jim kaɗan bayan Jeremy ya zama shugaba, don abokan aiki da nake jin a da muna da irin mahangar siyasa sun fara tsammani zan yi wani juyi da daukan matsaya da ba zan taɓa yarda da su ba - ko a kan tsaron ƙasa ko kasuwa guda ta Tarayyar Turai.
rows.output: This began just a short time after Jeremy became leader, as colleagues I had previously worked with who had a similar political outlook began to expect that I would take a turn and adopt positions that I would never agree with - either on defense or a single market for the European Union.
rows.reference: This started shortly after Jeremy became leader, as colleagues with whom I had previously thought I shared a similar political outlook began expecting me to do a U-turn and take positions I would never have otherwise agreed with - whether on national security or the EU single market.

rows.source: A kodayaushe na yi magana a cikin jama’a - kuma ba ruwan haƙiƙa abin da na ce - kawai sai tarun cin mutunci a kan kafar sadar zumunta ana kira ga sake zaɓe, ana watsi da siyasar ta tsakiya, ana faɗa mun cewa ya kamata na zama ba na cikin jam’iyyar Labour.
rows.output: I have always spoken out in public - and not just the usual, superficial things I say - only to be met with a barrage of insults on social media, being told to rejoin the party, being dismissed as a centrist, and being told that I should not be in the Labour Party.
rows.reference: Whenever I speak publicly - and it doesn't really matter what I say - there follows a tirade of abuse on social media calling for deselection, denouncing the politics of the centre, telling me I should not be in the Labour party.

rows.source: Kuma wannan ba kawai abin da na gani ne ba.
rows.output: And this is not the only thing I have seen.
rows.reference: And that is not just my experience.

rows.source: Haƙiƙa, na san na ti sa’a sosai fiye da sauran abokan aikina saboda umarce-umarce da ake fuskantowa a kaina sukan zama na siyasa.
rows.output: Of course, I know that I have been given more opportunities than my colleagues because the orders I face are often political in nature.
rows.reference: Indeed, I know I am more fortunate than some of my colleagues as the comments directed at me tend to be political.

rows.source: Ina cikin dan shayi na ra’ayin kwarewa da ƙudurtawa ta waɗannan abokan aikin waɗanda ke fuskantar wani cin mutunci ta fuska jinsi ko bambancin launin fata a kowace rana amma ba su taɓa gudu ba.
rows.output: I am in a state of shock and awe at the skills and dedication of these colleagues who face discrimination based on gender or race every day, but never run away.
rows.reference: I am in awe of the professionalism and determination of those colleagues who face a torrent of sexist or racist abuse every day but never shy away.

rows.source: Daya daga cikin ɓangarorin abu mafi ɓata rai a wannan lokaci na siyasa shi ne yadda lebur-lebur na cin mutunci suna zama ruwan dare.
rows.output: One of the most depressing aspects of this political season is the way that the smear campaigns have become the norm.
rows.reference: One of the most disappointing aspects of this era of politics is how levels of abuse have become normalised.

rows.source: Jeremy Corbyn ya ce a mako da ya wuce cewa ya kamata jam’iyyar Labour ta samar da wata al’adar haƙuri.
rows.output: Jeremy Corbyn said last week that the Labour party should be a culture of tolerance.
rows.reference: Jeremy Corbyn claimed last week that the Labour party should foster a culture of tolerance.

rows.source: Abin da yake zahiri shi ne yanzu mu ba wancan babbar majami’ar ne ba da kowane batu na “ba a yarda da iyawa ba” ko canjin dokokin zaɓe a ce jam’iyya tana zama karama.
rows.output: What is real is that we are now no longer that big a party on any issue of "unacceptability" or changes to the electoral laws that the party is small.
rows.reference: The reality is we are no longer that broad church and with every "no-confidence" motion or change of selection rules the party becomes narrower.

rows.source: Na sha samun sharawa da yawa a cikin shekaru biyu da suka wuce ana kira da na yi shiru, kar na yi surutu shi ke nan zan zama “ba wata matsala.”
rows.output: I have received a lot of criticism in the past two years for being too loud, for not being a "good girl."
rows.reference: I have had lots of advice over the past two years urging me to keep my head down, not to be so vocal and then I would "be all right."

rows.source: Amma ban shiga siyasa don na yi wannan abu ba.
rows.output: But I didn't get into politics because of this.
rows.reference: But that is not what I came into politics to do.

rows.source: Tun da ma na shiga jam’iyyar Labour shekaru 32 da suka wuce a matsayin wani yaro dan makaranta, da ya sami zaburarwa daga wazarai na gwamnatin Thatcher da a fakaice ta bar cikekken ajina na makaranta yana faɗuwa, na yi tunanin na zama gwarzon gyara ayyukan jama’a ga waɗanda ke buƙatar sosai - ko a matsayi na wani kansila na gida ko ministan gwamnati.
rows.output: Since I joined the Labour Party 32 years ago as a schoolboy, I had always been inspired by the radicalism of Thatcher's government and the way it left my comprehensive school in ruins, I thought I was destined to be a champion of public services for those who needed them most - whether as a local councillor or a government minister.
rows.reference: Ever since I joined Labour 32 years ago as a school pupil, provoked by the Thatcher government's neglect that had left my comprehensive school classroom literally falling down, I've sought to champion better public services for those who need them most - whether as a local councillor or government minister.

rows.source: Ban taɓa boye siyasata ba, har da cikin zaɓen da ya gabata.
rows.output: I have never hidden my politics, including in the previous elections.
rows.reference: I have never hidden my politics, including at the last election.

rows.source: Ba wani daga cikin Nottingham ta Gabas da za a ce ya shiga ruɗani game da matsayin ƙudurina da yankuna na rashin amincewa tare da shugabancin yanzu.
rows.output: None of the Eastern Nottinghamshire MPs have any idea about my position and the areas of disagreement with the current leadership.
rows.reference: No one in Nottingham East could have been in any way confused about my policy positions and areas of disagreement with the current leadership.

rows.source: Ga waɗanda suka tallata batu na ranar Juma’a, abin da dukka zan ce shi ne cewa a lokacin da ƙasar ke tattaki zuwa wani Brexit da zai cutar da iyalai, kasuwanci da ayyukan gwamnati, ban fahimci sha’awar ɓata lokaci da ƙarfin gwiwa ba a kan mubaya’a ta zuwa ga shugaban jam’iyyar Labour.
rows.output: To those who have been promoting the issue of Friday, what I would say is that at a time when the country is marching towards a Brexit that will harm families, businesses, and public services, I do not understand the desire to waste time and energy on sycophancy towards the leader of the Labour Party.
rows.reference: To those who promoted the motion on Friday, all I would say is that when the country is ploughing towards a Brexit that will hurt households, businesses and our public services, I do not understand the desire to waste time and energy on my loyalty to the Labour party leader.

rows.source: Amma a zahiri kuwa saƙo ɗaya da nake da shi ba zuwa ga Nottingham Momentum ne ba, zuwa ga mazaɓata ne, ko mambobin Labour ko a’a: Ina alfahari da yin aiki don jama’a kuma na yi alkawari cewa ba wani irin barazana sake zaɓe ko ruɗanin siyasa da zai hana ni yin aiki a cikin abin da na yi imani da shi shi ne mafi kyawun abubuwan da za su yi wa jama’a dadi gaba ɗaya.
rows.output: But in reality, the message I have is not to Nottingham Momentum, but to the electorate, whether they are Labour members or not: I am proud to work for the public and I have promised that no type of electoral fraud or political manipulation will stop me from working in what I believe is the best interest of the public.
rows.reference: But really the one message I have is not to Nottingham Momentum, it is to my constituents, whether Labour members or not: I am proud to serve you and I promise that no amount of deselection threats or political expediency will deter me from acting in what I believe are the best interests of you all.

rows.source: Chris Leslie mamban majalisa ne na Nottingham ta Gabasa
rows.output: Chris Leslie is a member of the Nottingham East constituency

rows.source: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Ayr da ba a doke ba ta yi sama
rows.output: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Ayr remained unbeaten

rows.source: Gwaje-gwaje guda biyu masu jinkiri sun tsallake sakamakon ƙarshe wani iri, amma babu shakka Ayr ya dace ya ci nasara a cikin wannan nishaɗi mai ban mamaki na wasan Premiership na Tennent na ranar.
rows.output: Two slow-motion experiments have come up short of the final result, but there is no doubt that Ayr was worthy of winning this thrilling Premiership Test match of Tennent's on the day.

rows.source: Daga ƙarshe, tsaronsu da ya fi girma ne, kamar ma samun damarsu ta yin magana sosai, wanda ta ɗauki gefen gidan kuma mai horar da ‘yan wasa Peter Murchie yana dukkan dalili da zai ji daɗi.
rows.output: Finally, their largest structure, like having their own voice, which took over the side of the house and the coach Peter Murchie for all reasons to be happy.
rows.reference: In the end, it was their superior defence, as much as their better chance-taking, which carried the home side and coach Peter Murchie had every right to be pleased.

rows.source: “An gwada mu a cikin wasanninmu har zuwa nan, kuma har yanzu ba a doke mu ba, don haka dole na yi murna,” inji shi.
rows.output: “We have been tested in our matches up to now, and we have not yet been defeated, so I must be happy,” he said.
rows.reference: "We've been tested over our games this far, and we're still unbeaten, so I have to be happy," he said.

rows.source: Robyn Christie na Melrose ya ce: “Yabo ya tabbata ga Ayr, sun ɗauki damammakinsu sosai fiye da yadda muka yi.”
rows.output: Robyn Christie of Melrose said: "Congratulations to Ayr, they took their chances a lot better than we did."
rows.reference: Robyn Christie of Melrose said: "Credit to Ayr, they took their chances better than we did."

rows.source: Gwajin mintina na 14 na gudunmawar Anderson, da  Frazier Climo ya sauya, sa Ayr a gaba, amma, wani rawayar kati don kyaftin na Scotland Rory Hughes, da Warriors suka sake don wasan, ya bari Melrose ta yi lambobin faɗa da Jason Baggot
rows.output: The 14-minute test of Anderson's contribution, with Frazier Climo's substitution, put Ayr ahead, but, a penalty kick for Scotland captain Rory Hughes, and the Warriors returned for the game, leaving Melrose to score the opening goal with Jason Baggot.
rows.reference: Grant Anderson's 14th minute try, converted by Frazier Climo, put Ayr in front, but, a yellow card for Scotland cap Rory Hughes, released for the game by Warriors, allowed Melrose to make numbers tell and Jason Baggot grabbed an unconverted try.

rows.source: Climo ya faɗaɗa shugabancin Ayr tare da wani fenalti, kafin, lokacin hutun rabin lokaci, ya ci shi ke nan ya musanya wani gwajin kai kaɗai don ya sa ya zama 17 zuwa 5 zuwa Ayr a hutun.
rows.output: Climo extended Ayr's lead with a header, before, during the half-time break, he scored again to make it 17 to 5 to Ayr in the interval.
rows.reference: Climo stretched the Ayr lead with a penalty, before, right on half-time, he scored then converted a solo try to make it 17-5 to Ayr at the break.

rows.source: Amma Melrose ta fara rabi na biyun ne daidai kuma Patrick Anderson ya yi kokari, da Baggot ya musanya, rage hanyar wucewar zuwa matakai biyar.
rows.output: But Melrose started the second half right on the button and Patrick Anderson tried, with Baggot, to reduce the passage to five steps.
rows.reference: But Melrose began the second half well and Patrick Anderson's try, converted by Baggot, reduced the leeway to five points.

rows.source: A da akwai a lokacin wani jinkiri mai tsayi don wani rauni mai yawa ga Ruaridh Knott, wanda aka ɗauka a kan makara, kuma sake farawar, Ayr ta tura gaba dan saman ta hanyar wani gwaji na Stafford McDowall, da Climo ya musanya.
rows.output: There was a long delay at the time for a serious injury to Ruaridh Knott, who was taken on the hour, and restarted, Ayr pushed forward the top scorer through a test of Stafford McDowall, with Climo substituted.
rows.reference: There was then a lengthy hold-up for a serious injury to Ruaridh Knott, who was stretchered off, and from the restart, Ayr surged further ahead through a Stafford McDowall try, converted by Climo.

rows.source: Sa’an nan an ba wa muƙaddashin kyaftin ɗin Ayr Blair Macpherson kati rawaya, haka kuma, Melrose ya sa mutumin ya ƙara biya wani gwajin Bruce Colvine da ba a musanya ba, daga ƙarshe wani mummuna harin matsi.
rows.output: Then the designated captain of Ayr, Blair Macpherson, was given a yellow card, as was Melrose, who was also ordered to pay a fine of £ 500 for a non-reporting test by Bruce Colvine, finally a nasty bout of cramp.
rows.reference: Ayr acting captain Blair Macpherson was then yellow-carded, and again, Melrose made the extra man pay with an unconverted Bruce Colvine try, at the end of a spell of fierce pressure.

rows.source: Ɓangaren gidan ya dawo, amma, kuma a lokacin da aka ba da kati rawaya a Struan Hutchinson don tunkarar Climo ba tare da ƙwallo ba, daga layin wajen fenalti the penalty, MacPherson ya taɓa ƙasa daga bayan tunkuɗewar Ayr da ke kusantowa.
rows.output: The team returned to the field, however, and when a yellow card was given to Struan Hutchinson for a foul on Climo, from the penalty line, MacPherson touched the ball from behind Ayr's advancing players.
rows.reference: The home side came back, however, and when Struan Hutchinson was yellow-carded for tackling Climo without the ball, from the penalty line-out, MacPherson touched down at the back of the advancing Ayr maul.

rows.source: Climo ya musanyu, kamar yadda ya sake yi aƙalla daga farawa, bayan Kyle Rowe ya tara bugun akwati na David Armstrong kuma ya aika Gregor Henry wani waje don gwajin gefen gida na biyar.
rows.output: Climo was replaced, as he had been at least from the start, after Kyle Rowe collected a corner kick from David Armstrong and sent Gregor Henry off for a fifth-minute home test.
rows.reference: Climo converted, as he did again almost from the restart, after Kyle Rowe gathered David Armstrong's box kick and sent flanker Gregor Henry away for the home side's fifth try.

rows.output: A 56-year-old man is appearing as Jack Jarvis in the popular BBC series, which is written by and starring comedian Greg Hemphill.
rows.reference: The 56-year-old plays Jack Jarvis on the popular BBC show, which he writes and co-stars with long-time comedy partner Greg Hemphill.

rows.source: Su biyun sun sanar da cewa jerin nau’uka na tara da ke zuwa za su zama na ƙarshe a cikin gudanar da shirin, kuma ya bayyana Kiernan yana shirya rayuwa bayana Craiglang.
rows.output: Both of them announced that the remaining nine episodes of the season would be the last to be produced, and it was revealed that Kiernan is preparing to move on from Craiglang.
rows.reference: The duo have announced that the upcoming ninth series will be the final one in the show's run, and it appears Kiernan is planning for life after Craiglang.

rows.source: A cewar rubutaccen labari na jere-jere na kamfani, shi ne darakta na Adriftmorn Limited.
rows.output: According to the company's official website, he is the director of Adriftmorn Limited.

rows.source: Ɗan wasan kwaikwayon ya ki yin ya ce wani kome a kan labarin, kodayake wata kafar labari ta Scottish Sun ta tsegunta cewa Kiernan yana neman ya shiga cikin “kasuwar sayar da abinci mai ci gaba” ta Glasgow.
rows.output: The actor refused to comment on the story, although a Scottish Sun newspaper reported that Kiernan was looking to join the "fast food market" in Glasgow.
rows.reference: The actor declined to comment on the story, though a Scottish Sun source hinted that Kiernan was looking to get involved in Glasgow's "thriving restaurant trade."

rows.source: Dawo da shi haƙƙinmu ne.”

rows.source: A cikin gaba ɗaya Bolivia da ke kewaye da ƙasa, tuna rasa wani yankin bakin teku ga Chile wani mummunan rikicin albarkar abu na ƙarni na 19 har yanzu a fili a yake - don saboda shi ne buƙatar su sake bi ta ruwan Tekun Pacific Ocean.
rows.output: In the entire Bolivian territory, the loss of a coastal region to Chile was a major conflict over natural resources in the 19th century that is still visible today - because it was the need for them to go through the waters of the Pacific Ocean.
rows.reference: Throughout landlocked Bolivia, the memory of a coastline lost to Chile in a bloody 19th-century resource conflict is still vivid - as is the yearning to sail the Pacific Ocean once more.

rows.source: Waɗannan ire-iren fata suna watakila mafi girma a cikin shekaru, a lokacin da Bolivia din ke jiran wani ƙaramin hukunci daga kotun duniya a ranar 1 ga Oktoba bayan shekaru biyar ana jin bahasi.
rows.output: These types of fat are likely the largest in the world, in the time when Bolivia was waiting for a small judgment from the international court on October 1 after five years of hearing.
rows.reference: Those hopes are perhaps at their highest in decades, as Bolivia awaits a ruling by the international court of justice on 1 October after five years of deliberations.

rows.source: "Bolivia tana da kuzari, da halin haɗin kai da kwanciyar hankali, kuma ba shakka tana tsammanin wani kyakkyawan batu da zai fito,” inji Roberto Calzadilla, wani jami’in diflomasiyya na Bolivia.
rows.output: "Bolivia has a lot of energy, a lot of unity, and a lot of stability, and we are sure that we will have a very good issue to present," said Roberto Calzadilla, a diplomat from Bolivia.
rows.reference: "Bolivia has the momentum, a spirit of unity and serenity, and is of course expecting with a positive view the outcome," said Roberto Calzadilla, a Bolivian diplomat.

rows.output: Independent Scottish schools hold a written record of excellence in education, and this continued in 2018 with a section of examination results that excelled, which only a few individuals achieved in combination with sports, arts, music, and other community activities.

rows.source: Sashen Turai na Thomas Bjorn, mai neman riƙe kofin ba su ci nasara ba a Hazeltine shekaru biyu da suka wuce, da mamaye wani rashin sa’a a sashen Amurka a cikin ƙwallaye huɗu na safe, inda suka ɗauki jere-jere 3 da 1.
rows.output: The European section of Thomas Bjorn, who were seeking to retain the cup, did not win at Hazeltine two years ago, and were overwhelmed by a bad luck in the American section in the four morning holes, where they took a 3-1 lead.
rows.reference: Thomas Bjorn's European side, bidding to retain the trophy they lost at Hazeltine two years ago, dominated a misfiring American side in the morning fourballs, taking the series 3-1.

rows.source: Amurka ta ƙara turjiya a cikin huɗu-huɗun, tana ci nasarar wasanni biyu, amma sun gagara ci a cikin tawayar.
rows.output: The United States added a basket in the final seconds, winning two games, but failed to win in the tiebreaker.
rows.reference: The U.S. offered more resistance in the foursomes, winning two matches, but they could not eat into the deficit.

rows.source: Sashen Jim Furyk suna buƙatar ɗigo-ɗigo daga wasanni ɗaiɗaiku 12 na ranar Lahadi don riƙe kofin.
rows.output: Jim Furyk's group needs to dig out of a 12-stroke deficit on Sunday to keep the trophy.
rows.reference: Jim Furyk's side need eight points from Sunday's 12 singles matches to retain the trophy.

rows.source: Fleetwood shi ne farkon rookie na Turai da ya ci ɗigo-ɗigo huɗu a yayin da shi da Molinari, da aka cewa "Molliwood" bayan wani ƙarshen mako da ake magana kuma kawai su ne haɗin biyu da suka ci ɗigo-ɗigo hudu daga budewa wasanninsu huɗu a cikin tarihin Ryder Cup.
rows.output: Fleetwood was the first European rookie to win four holes in a row during the opening session, as he and Molinari, dubbed "Molliwood" after a weekend that was said to be the end of the world, were the only two-ball pairing to win four holes from the start of their four-ball matches in the history of the Ryder Cup.
rows.reference: Fleetwood is the first European rookie to win four points in a row while he and Molinari, dubbed "Molliwood" after a sensational weekend are only the second pair to win four points from their opening four matches in Ryder Cup history.

rows.source: Bayan sun buge Woods da Patrick Reed a cikin ƙwallaye huɗun sai kuma suka tashi suke buge Woods da rookie na Amurka Bryson Dechambeau ta kuma wani abin gani na 5 da 4.
rows.output: After they beat Woods and Patrick Reed in the four-ball, they then beat Woods and American rookie Bryson Dechambeau by another 5 and 4.

rows.output: Woods, who pulled himself into two games on Sunday, showed a sign of intelligence but now has lost 19 of his games in four quarters and four in a row with seven in a row in a row.

rows.output: Only once in the history of the Ryder Cup has a team come back from a deficit of four points in singles, although as the holders of the cup, the Americans needed only to draw to retain it.

rows.source: Ri ya yi dube ne ga wani jawabin hadin gwiwa daga Kim Jong Un da Donald Trump a wani babban taro da aka taba yi tsakanin shugaban Amurka mai ci da wani shugaban Koriya ta Arewa a cikin Singapore a ranar 12 ga Yuni, a lokacin da Kim ya yi alkawari yin aiki zuwa ga "rage makaman nukiliya a zirin Koriya" a lokacin da Trump ya yi alkawarin ba da garanti na tsaron Koriya ta Arewa din.

rows.source: Duk da haka, lafazin jawabin na Ri ya dan zama daban daga na shekarar da ta gabata, a lokacin da ya gaya wa Babban Taro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniyar cewa cikin yankin Amurka da rokokin Koriya wani abu ne da dole zai wakana bayan “Mista Shugaba Mai Neman Bala’i” Trup ya kira Kim da wani “mutum mai roka” da ke neman kashe kansa.
rows.output: However, the tone of Ri's speech was somewhat different from that of the previous year, when he told the General Assembly of the United Nations that the American and Korean rockets were a matter that would have to be addressed after "Mr. President of the Apocalypse" Trup called Kim a "man of rockets" who was seeking to commit suicide.

rows.output: This year at the United Nations, Trump, who last year threatened to "completely destroy" North Korea, praised Kim for his strength in taking steps to reduce his nuclear arsenal, but said that there was still work to be done and that sanctions would remain in place until North Korea denuclearized.

rows.output: A new course at Harvard University this year has provided all its students with additional sleep in an attempt to curb the growing trend of studying late at night by drinking coffee all night.

rows.output: But we believe they have the freedom to know - just like you have the freedom to know the risks to health of smoking,' Professor Czeisler added.

rows.output: The tradition of sleeping in a "full moon" is still around, and it is, in fact, a reflection of the fact that modern technology and the pressure on students to perform academically are making it increasingly difficult to get a good night's sleep.

rows.output: It should be a guarantee of getting enough sleep, a good one, to be a weapon for a student to hide their sadness, fatigue, and anxiety, to prevent them - or to avoid obesity, because sleep deprivation often leads to a state of hunger, making them always feel hungry.

rows.output: Raymond So, a 19-year-old California student majoring in biology and environmental science, helped Professor Czeisler design the course after taking one of his classes during his freshman year at Harvard.

rows.source: Ya ce kwas ɗin ya buɗe masa idanuwansa da jan hankali don tura samun kwas ɗin a faɗin makarantar.
rows.output: He said the class opened his eyes and ears to the world, and he was determined to make the class a part of his life.

rows.output: He hopes that the next step, he will ask all the students of the additional curriculum after graduation to complete a preparatory course for admission to a competitive university.

rows.source: Farfesa Czeisler  ya ba shawarar cewa ya kamata ɗalibai su kula da saita wata faɗakarwa ta lokacin da za su kwanta barci, har ma da lokacin da za su farka, da kuma sanin illolin cutarwa na ‘shuɗin haske’ da ke fitowa daga fuskokin kayayyakin lantarki da haske na LED, wanda zai iya jefa tsarin lafiyarku ta tashi a barci a cikin wani yanayi, wanda zai kai ga matsalolin kasa barci.
rows.output: Professor Czeisler suggested that students should be aware of setting an alarm for the time they need to go to bed, even if it is not the time they will wake up, and be aware of the health risks of 'blue light' emitted from electronic devices and LED lights, which can interfere with their sleep-wake cycle, leading to sleep disorders.
rows.reference: Prof Czeisler recommended that students should consider setting an alarm for when to go to bed, as well as for when to wake, and be aware of the harmful effects of 'blue light' emitted by electronic screens and LED lighting, which can throw your circadian rhythm out of kilter, leading to problems falling asleep.

rows.source: Livingston 1 da Rangers 0: Cin Menga ya ƙasƙantar da mutanen Gerrard
rows.output: Livingston 1, Rangers 0: Menga's goal silences Gerrard's men
rows.reference: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Menga goal downs Gerrard's men

rows.source: Rangers ta sami koma baya a lokacin da harin Dolly Menga ya taƙaita gefen Steven Gerrard da ya rabu zuwa ga ci 1 da 0 a Livingston.
rows.output: Rangers were dealt a blow when Dolly Menga's shot deflected off Steven Gerrard's head and into the net, giving Livingston a 1-0 lead.
rows.reference: Rangers suffered another bout of away-day blues as Dolly Menga's strike consigned Steven Gerrard's disjointed side to a 1-0 defeat at Livingston.

rows.source: Gefen Ibrox suna neman su samar da cinsu na farko ne a kan hanyar tun cin nasara ta 4 da 1 a Fabarairu a St Johnstone, amma ƙungiyar Gary Holt ta janyo doke kawai  Gerrard karo na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 games a matsayin manaja inda ya bar gefensa da ɗigo-ɗigo takwas a ruguje kan hanyar Ladbrokes shugabannin Hearts na Premiership.
rows.output: The Ibrox side are looking to provide their manager with his first win on the road since a 4-1 victory at St Johnstone in February, but Gary Holt's team have only lost twice in 18 games under his management, where he has left his side with eight goals conceded on the way.
rows.reference: The Ibrox side were looking to record their first win on the road since February's 4-1 triumph at St Johnstone, but Gary Holt's team inflicted just Gerrard's second defeat in 18 games as manager to leave his side eight points adrift of runaway Ladbrokes Premiership leaders Hearts.

rows.source: Menga sun kai harin ne mintina bakwai kafin rabin lokaci kuma wani bugun gajeren layi na Rangers din a kan jan hankali da bai taɓa kama da yin lebur.
rows.output: The men were in the attack just seven minutes before half-time and a low cross from Rangers' corner was met with a header that was never going to be on target.
rows.reference: Menga struck seven minutes before half-time and a Rangers line-up short on inspiration never looked like levelling.

rows.source: Yayin da Rangers yanzu ta sauka ƙasa zuwa ga matsayi na shida, Livingston kuwa ta hau sama ne zuwa ta uku kuma kawai a bayan Hibernian a kan ci na bambanci.
rows.output: While Rangers are now down to sixth place, Livingston have climbed up to third and are only behind Hibernian on goal difference.
rows.reference: While Rangers now drop down to sixth spot, Livingston climb to third and only behind Hibernian on goal difference.

rows.source: Kuma za a iya samun ƙarin tashin hankali a ajiye ga Rangers bayan da sai da aka yi jinyar mai lura da layi Calum Spence na wani raunin ka bayan da a bayyane aka jefo wani abu daga ƙarshen wurin.
rows.output: And there could be further action taken against Rangers after the linesman, Calum Spence, was treated for a head injury following a clear handball by a player at the end of the game.
rows.reference: And there could be further trouble in store for Rangers after linesman Calum Spence had to be treated for a head wound after an object was apparently thrown from the away end.

rows.source: Gerrard ya yi canje-canje takwas zuwa ga ɓangaren wanda ya jefa Ayr cikin wasannin kafin ƙarshe na Kofin Betfred.
rows.output: Gerrard made eight changes to the side that was beaten by Ayr in the final of the Betfred Cup.
rows.reference: Gerrard made eight changes to the side which swept past Ayr into the Betfred Cup semi-finals.

rows.source: Holt, a wani ɓangaren, ya tafi tare da irin Livi 11 ɗin wanda ta cire ɗigo daga Hearts mako da wuce kuma da ya yi murna da irin yadda waɗanda ya horar suka wahalar da masu adawarsu a kowane juyin da aka yi.
rows.output: Holt, on the other hand, went with the Liv 11 version that removed the digo from Hearts a week ago and was delighted with the way his team had troubled their opponents in each of the turns made.
rows.reference: Holt, on the other hand, went with the same Livi 11 which took a point off Hearts last week and he would have been delighted with the way his well-drilled outfit suffocated their opponents at every turn.

rows.source: Za a kila ce Rangers sun mamaye kame ƙwallon amma Livingston sun yi abubuwa da yawa da ƙwallon da suka samu.
rows.output: The Rangers may have dominated the ball, but Livingston made a lot with the ball they had.
rows.reference: Rangers may have dominated possession but Livingston did more with the ball they had.

rows.source: Ya kamata a ce sun ci kawai a mintina biyu na farawa lokacin musayar Menga ta farko da ta aika Scott Pittman ta cikin cin Allan McGregor amma mai tsaron tsakiya ya faɗaɗa damarsa babba sosai.
rows.output: They should have won only in the first two minutes of Menga's first exchange with Scott Pittman, but the goalkeeper Allan McGregor made a big save to increase their lead.
rows.reference: They should have scored just two minutes in when Menga's first-time lay-off sent Scott Pittman through on Allan McGregor's goal but the midfielder tugged his big chance wide.

rows.source: Wani dukan da ba tarewa na Keaghan Jacobs sai ya sami gola Craig Halkett amma abokinsa mai tsaro Alan Lithgow ya iya kawai faɗaɗawa ne a bayan matsayar.
rows.output: A corner that was never coming was Keaghan Jacobs' to take, but his defensive partner Craig Halkett was only able to head it away in the direction of the goal.
rows.reference: A deep Keaghan Jacobs free-kick then found skipper Craig Halkett but his defensive partner Alan Lithgow could only stab wide at the back post.

rows.source: Rangers ta dai kama sarrafa amma akwai alamar ƙarin fata maimakon yarda game da wasansu a ukun ƙarshe.
rows.output: Rangers were in control, but there was a sign of more hope than acceptance about their performance in the last third.
rows.reference: Rangers did grab control but there looked to be more hope than belief about their play in the final third.

rows.source: Alfredo Morelos ba shakka ya ji ya kamata a ce ya sami wani bugu daga kai sai gola a makin kashi na uku na rabin sa’a kamar yadda shi da Steven Lawless suka yi karo amma alƙalin wasa Steven Thomson ya manta koke-koke na Colombia.
rows.output: Alfredo Morelos was clearly offside when he met Steven Lawless in the third minute of injury time, but referee Steven Thomson ignored the Colombian's protests.
rows.reference: Alfredo Morelos certainly felt he should have had a penalty on the quarter-hour mark as he and Steven Lawless collided but referee Steven Thomson waved away the Colombian's appeals.

rows.source: Rangers ta yi ƙoƙarin kawai buge-buge na rabin farko na biyu a kan abin hari amma tsohon golan Ibrox Liam Kelly bai nuna wata damuwa ba daga bugun kai na Lassana Coulibaly da kuma wani harin sauri na Ovie Ejaria.
rows.output: Rangers tried to just force a half-time equaliser in the second half on the break but former Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly showed no concern from Lassana Coulibaly's header and a quick shot from Ovie Ejaria.
rows.reference: Rangers managed just two first-half shots on target but former Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly was barely troubled by Lassana Coulibaly's header and a tame Ovie Ejaria strike.

rows.source: Yayin da buɗin da Livi ta samu na mintina 34 kila ya zama a kan sake wasa, ba wanda zai iya ƙi sun cancance shi don cinsu da kawai suka samu.
rows.output: While Livi's 34-minute opening may have been on the generous side, no one can deny that they deserved it for the only goal they scored.

rows.output: Scott Arfield did not react where Declan Gallagher headed the ball to Scott Robinson, who missed the opportunity to take Menga's low finish.

rows.source: Gerrard ya yi aiki a hutun inda ya sauya Coulibaly da Ryan Kent kuma sauyi ya kusan samar da wani tasirin nan da nan a matsayin mai kai hari ta kusurwa na sakun da ka yi wa Morelos amma mai ban sha’awa Kelly ya yi gudu daga layinsa don ya toshe.
rows.output: Gerrard worked the bench where he replaced Coulibaly and Ryan Kent and the substitution almost had an immediate impact as a corner was delivered to the far post by Morelos but Kelly was alert to the danger and cleared it.

rows.output: But Livingston continued to prod the players into the actual game they were enjoying, with Lithgow and Halkett getting a long ball over the top in behind the defense.
rows.reference: But Livingston continued to suck the visitors into playing exactly the type of game they enjoy, with Lithgow and Halkett sweeping up long ball after long ball.

rows.source: Ɓangaren Holt da sun faɗaɗa matsayinsu na gaba a cikin matakan ƙarshe amma McGregor ya tsaya sosai ya hana Jacobs kafin Lithgow ya yi bugun ka daga kwanar.
rows.output: The Holt section had extended their lead in the final stages but McGregor was able to hold off Jacobs before Lithgow scored a goal from the day's play.
rows.reference: Holt's side could have stretched their lead in the final stages but McGregor stood up well to deny Jacobs before Lithgow headed wide from the corner.

rows.output: Rangers' replacement winger Glenn Middleton was denied a late penalty when he tried to round the goalkeeper, but was thwarted by Jacobs.
rows.reference: Rangers substitute Glenn Middleton had another late claim for a penalty as he tangled with Jacobs but again Thomson looked away.

rows.output: The method involves growing immune cells from a patient's body, where they are modified in a laboratory to be able to "see" a protein molecule that is known as HER2, and then reintroduced into the patient's body.

rows.output: Professor Jay Berzofsky, of the American Sankara Cancer Center in Bethesda, Maryland, said: "Our results suggest that a needle biopsy can be beneficial."

rows.source: Ana nuna kyautar fasahar Atkinson ta barkwanci a zahiri a fili, amma ban dariyar tana zama kamar ba ta da ƙarfi sosai kuma da shirme, musamman idan aka duba sanannun fina-finai "da ba wasa" irin su nau'ukan 007 da Mission Impossible su da kansu suna yanzu da ƙarfin gwiwa samar da barkwanci a matsayin ɗanɗanonsu.
rows.output: Atkinson's comedic talent is evident in his physical comedy, but the humor is often weak and forced, especially when compared to more popular "non-comedic" franchises like the James Bond and Mission Impossible series, which have now mastered the art of incorporating comedy as a secondary element.
rows.reference: Atkinson's gift for physical comedy is on display, but the humour feels pretty underpowered and weirdly superfluous, especially as the "serious" film brands like 007 and Mission Impossible themselves now confidently offer comedy as an ingredient.

rows.output: “I’m a man in a state of peace and all is well,” the player added, smiling.

rows.source: Lauyoyi masu kare Ronaldo su na shirin su kai ƙarar Der Spiegel akan zargin, wanda suka kira “Rihoton da bashi da hujja akan zargi ta yankin sirri,” bisa ga Reuters.
rows.output: Lawyers defending Ronaldo are planning to sue Der Spiegel over the allegations, which they have called "A report with no evidence on a charge in the private sphere," according to Reuters.

rows.source: Lawyer Christian Schertz ya ce dan wasan zai nemi cin tara akan “ɓata masa halaye na dabi'a, a cikin adadin da ya dace da nauyin laifin, wanda yakan iya zama mafi tsananin cin zarafin haƙin ɗan adam a cikin shekarun nan.”
rows.output: Attorney Christian Schertz said the player would seek compensation for "the infringement of his personality rights, in an amount appropriate to the gravity of the offense, which can be the most severe violation of human rights in recent years."

rows.output: The allegations are that it occurred in June 2009 in a large room of the Palm Otel and Casino in Las Vegas.
rows.reference: The alleged incident is said to have taken place in June 2009 at a suite at the Palms Hotel and Casino in Las Vegas.

rows.source: Bayan sun hadu a wani gidan wasan kwaikwayo na dare, Ronaldo da Mayorga wai sun koma dakin dan wasan, wurin da a zargin ya mata fyaɗe a duburi, bisa ga takardun da aka saka a fayil ɗin dake Kotun Gundumar Clark a Nevada.
rows.output: After meeting at a nightclub, Ronaldo and Mayorga reportedly returned to the player's room, where they allegedly engaged in sexual intercourse in a bathroom, according to documents filed in the Clark County Court in Nevada.
rows.reference: After meeting in a nightclub, Ronaldo and Mayorga reportedly went back to the player's room, where he allegedly anally raped her, according to papers filed at Clark County District Court in Nevada.

rows.source: Mayorga tayi ikirari cewa Ronaldo ya faɗi akan gwiwan shi bayan hakan kuma ya ce mata “kashi 99” “mutumin kirki” wanda ke samun akasi daga “kashi ɗaya”.
rows.output: Mayorga claims that Ronaldo fell on his knee after that and told her "99 bones" "a kind man" who is getting "one bone" from "99 bones".
rows.reference: Mayorga claims Ronaldo fell to his knees after the alleged incident and told her he was "99 percent" a "good guy" let down by the "one percent."

rows.output: They claim in their documents that Ronaldo was surprised to learn that the two had been having sex, but that was part of the agreement.
rows.reference: The documents claim that Ronaldo confirmed the pair had sex, but that it was consensual.

rows.source: Mayorga kuma tayi ikirari cewa ta je wajen ‘yan sanda kuma an ɗauki hotunan raunin da ta ji a asibit, amma daga baya ta yadda da sulhu a wajen kotu saboda ta ji “tsoron ramuwa” kuma ta damu akan “dizguwa a fuskar mutane.”
rows.output: Mayorga also claimed that she went to the police station and took pictures of the injuries she sustained in the hospital, but later she reached a settlement in court because she was "afraid of reprisal" and concerned about "disfigurement on her face."

rows.source: Yar shekara 34 ɗn yanzu tana neman juya sulhun a yayin da ta ci gaba da fuskantar kunci daga abun da ya farun.
rows.output: Now 34, she is seeking to turn her life around while still facing the consequences of her past.

rows.source: Ronaldo yana kan komawa Real Madrid daga Manchester United a lokacin da farmakin da ake zargin ya faru, kuma wannan ranin ya koma babban kungiyar kwallon Italia Juventus a yarjejeniyar Yuro miliyan100.
rows.output: Ronaldo was returning to Real Madrid from Manchester United at the time of the alleged attack, and that day he was transferred to Italian football club Juventus in a £100 million deal.
rows.reference: Ronaldo was on the verge of joining Real Madrid from Manchester United at the time of the alleged assault, and this summer moved to Italian giants Juve in a €100 million deal.

rows.source: Brexit: UK ‘har abada zata yi da na sanin’ rasa masu kera motoci
rows.output: Brexit: UK 'har abada zata yi da na sanin' rasa masu kera motoci
rows.reference: Brexit: UK 'would forever regret' losing carmakers

rows.source: UK “zata yi da na sanin shi har abada” idan tayi rashin matsayin ta na shugabancin kera mota bayan Brexit, Sakataren Sana’a Greg Clark yace.
rows.output: The UK "will be forever known as the home of car manufacturing" if it fails to maintain its position as the leading car producer after Brexit, said Business Secretary Greg Clark.
rows.reference: The UK "would regret it forever" if it lost its status as a world leader in car manufacturing after Brexit, Business Secretary Greg Clark has said.

rows.source: Ya kara cewa abun “damuwa ne” cewa Toyota UK ta fada wa BBC cewa idan Britain ta fita EU ba tare da yarjejeniya ba zata sayar da aiki na dan wani lokaci a masana’antar ta a Burnaston, kusa da Derby.
rows.output: He added that it was "concerning" that Toyota UK had told the BBC that if Britain left the EU without a deal, it would temporarily halt production at its car plant in Burnaston, near Derby.
rows.reference: He added it was "concerning" that Toyota UK had told the BBC that if Britain left the EU without a deal it would temporarily halt production at its factory in Burnaston, near Derby.

rows.source: “Mu na bukatar yarjejeniya,” Mr Clark ya ce.
rows.output: "We need an agreement," Mr. Clark said.
rows.reference: "We need a deal," Mr Clark said.

rows.source: Kamfanin Japan din na mota yace tasirin jinkiri a iyakar kasa a yanayin Brexit babu yarjejeniya zai iya kwao rasa ayyuka.
rows.output: The Japanese automaker said the impact of a hard Brexit at the border would be "unavoidable" and could lead to job losses.
rows.reference: The Japanese carmaker said the impact of border delays in the event of a no-deal Brexit could cost jobs.

rows.source: Masana’antar Burnaston din - wanda ke hada Toyota Auris da Avensis - sun kera kusan motoci 150,000 bara wanda a ciki kashi 90 aka fitar zuwa sauran kasashen Turai.
rows.output: The Burnaston plant, which manufactures the Toyota Auris and Avensis, produced around 150,000 vehicles last year, with 90 percent exported to other European countries.
rows.reference: The Burnaston plant - which makes Toyota's Auris and Avensis - produced nearly 150,000 cars last year of which 90% were exported to the rest of the European Union.

rows.source: “A gani na shi ne idan Britain ta fita EU a karshen Maris zamu ga sayawar kira a masana;antar mu,” inji Mavin Cooke, Manajin Direkta na Toyota a Burnaston.
rows.output: "I can see it now that if Britain leaves the EU in March we will see a surge in demand for our cars," said Mavin Cooke, head of manufacturing at Toyota in Burnaston.
rows.reference: "My view is that if Britain crashes out of the EU at the end of March we will see production stops in our factory," said Marvin Cooke, Toyota's managing director at Burnaston.

rows.source: Wasu masu kera motocin UK sun nuna jin tsoro akan fita EU ba tare da yarjejniya ba akan yadda kasuwancin tsallaken iyaka zai kasance, har da Honda, BMW da Jaguar Land Rover.
rows.output: Some UK car manufacturers have expressed concern about leaving the EU without a deal on how trade across the border would work, including Honda, BMW and Jaguar Land Rover.
rows.reference: Other UK car manufacturers have raised fears about leaving the EU without agreement on how cross-border trade will function, including Honda, BMW and Jaguar Land Rover.

rows.source: BMW, kamar misali, ta ce zata kulle karamin masana’antar ta da ke Oxford na tsawon wata daya bayan Brexit.
rows.output: BMW, for example, said it would close its small engine plant in Oxford for a month after Brexit.
rows.reference: BMW, for example, says it will close its Mini plant in Oxford for a month following Brexit.

rows.source: Babban damuwan yana dangance da abun da makera motoci suka ce ne dangane da hadarin samun kayayyakin aiki idan akayi Brexit ba yarjejeniya.
rows.output: The main concern is related to the content of the automotive industry's statements regarding the risk of having goods in place in the event of a hard Brexit.
rows.reference: The main concerns relate to what carmakers say are supply chain risks in the event of a no-deal Brexit.

rows.source: Ana aiwatar da hanyar sarrafawar Toyota na akan tsarin “gab-da-lokaci”, yadda sassa su na isowa ko wani minti 37 daga masu kaya duk daga UK da EU na motocin da ake kira dan sari.
rows.output: Toyota's approach to vehicle management is based on a "just-in-time" system, where parts are delivered to the assembly line every 37 minutes from suppliers in the UK and EU.
rows.reference: Toyota's production line is run on a "just-in-time" basis, with parts arriving every 37 minutes from suppliers in both the UK and the EU for cars made to order.

rows.source: Idan UK ta bar EU ba tare dayarjejeniya ba ranar 29 ga watan Maris, za’a iya samun matsaloli a iyaka wanda masana’antar ta ce yakan iya kawo jinkiri da rashin isashen sassa.
rows.output: If the UK leaves the EU without a deal on 29 March, there could be problems at the border which the industry says can cause delays and shortages.
rows.reference: If the UK leaves the EU without a deal on 29 March, there could be disruption at the border which the industry says could lead to delays and shortages of parts.

rows.source: Ba zai yiyu Toyota ta rike fiye da kayan aiki na kwana daya a masana’antar ta na Derbyshire, kamfanin ta ce, dan haka aiki zai saya.
rows.output: It is not possible for Toyota to retain more than one shift of production at its Derbyshire plant, the company said, so work will be bought.
rows.reference: It would be impossible for Toyota to hold more than a day's worth of inventory at its Derbyshire plant, the company said, and so production would be stopped.

rows.source: Mr Clark ya ce tsarin binciken Theresa May na dagantakan gaba da EU an “asalin tsara shi dan kauyce wa wadannan binciken a iyaka.”
rows.output: Mr. Clark said that Theresa May's approach to future relations with the EU was "a preordained way to avoid these investigations at the margins."
rows.reference: Mr Clark said Theresa May's Chequers plan for future relations with the EU is "precisely calibrated to avoid those checks at the border."

rows.source: “Mu na bukatar mu samu yarjejeniya. Mu na so mu samu mafi kyakkyawan yarjejeniya da zai bamu daman kamar yadda na fada ba kawai nasaran da zamu ji dadin shi a halin yanzu ba amma mu samu yin amfani da wannan daman,” ya fada a tsarin Yau na Radiyon BBC 4.
rows.output: “We need to get a deal. We want to get the best deal possible that will allow us to benefit as much as I said, not just the success that we will enjoy now, but to be able to use this opportunity,” he said in the BBC 4’s Today program.
rows.reference: "We need to have a deal. We want to have the best deal that will allow as I say not just the success at present to be enjoyed but for us to grasp this opportunity," he told BBC Radio 4's Today programme.

rows.source: “Hujjan da ba na Toyota ba kawai amma har da na wasu makera shi ne mu na asalin bukatar mu ci gaba da abun da yake nasarraren samar da kayaki.”
rows.output: “The evidence is not just for Toyota, but also for other manufacturers, that we need to continue with the successful production of vehicles.”
rows.reference: "The evidence from not just Toyota but other manufacturers is that we need to absolutely be able to continue what has been a highly successful set of supply chains."

rows.source: Toyota ta kasa fadan tsawon lokacin da za a sayar da aiki, amma a hangen gaba, sun bada gargadin cewa farashi zai rage karfin gasar masana’antar kuma hakan zai kai ga asarar ayyuka.
rows.output: Toyota's long-term contract negotiations are not expected to be easy, but they have warned that prices will be reduced to maintain competitiveness and avoid job losses.
rows.reference: Toyota was unable to say how long production would be stopped, but in the longer term, warned that added costs would reduce the plant's competitiveness and eventually cost jobs.

rows.output: Peter Tsouvallaris, who worked at Burnaston for 24 years and was the chairman of the trade union, said that the members are still concerned: "In my experience, as soon as these operations are gone, they never come back.

rows.output: The meeting between Donald Trump and Deputy Attorney General Rod Rosenstein could be "postponed for a week" amid the ongoing controversy over Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh's testimony, the White House said on Sunday.

rows.output: Rosenstein oversees a special counsel's office, led by Robert Mueller, who is investigating Russian interference in the election, collusion between Trump's campaign and Russia, and the potential obstruction of justice by the President.

rows.reference: They added that moving children to the tent city without providing enough time to prepare them emotionally or to say goodbye to friends could compound trauma that many are already struggling with.

rows.source: Sham ta fada wa ‘sojojin mamaya’ na Amurka, Faransa da Turkiya zasu janye ba tare da jinkiri ba
rows.output: Sham told the 'invading' American, French, and Turkish forces to withdraw immediately
rows.reference: Syria tells US, French and Turkish 'occupying forces' to withdraw immediately

rows.source: A jawabi ma Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, Ministan Harkokin Waje al-Moualem yayi kira ga masu gudun hijira na da su dawo gida, duk da yakin kasar yanzu yana cikin shekara na takwas.
rows.output: In a speech to the United Nations, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, al-Moualem, called on refugees to return home, despite the civil war in the country now in its eighth year.
rows.reference: Addressing the UN General Assembly, Foreign Minister Walid al-Moualem also called on Syrian refugees to come home, even though the country's war is now in its eighth year.

rows.source: Moualem, wanda yake kuma matsayin mataimakin firayam minista, yace sojojin kasar wajen su na Sham ne ba tare da izini ba, a karkashin babatun yaki da ta’addanci, kuma “za’a magance su yadda ya kamata.”
rows.output: Moualem, who also holds the position of deputy prime minister, said that the armed forces of the country, in their operations against the Sham, have acted without prior permission, under the banner of combating terrorism, and "will be dealt with accordingly."
rows.reference: Moualem, who also serves as deputy prime minister, said the foreign forces were on Syrian soil illegally, under the pretext of fighting terrorism, and "will be dealt with accordingly."

rows.source: “Dole su janye ba tare da jinkiri ba kuma ba tare da wani sharaɗi ba,” ya fada wa taron.
rows.output: "They must withdraw immediately and unconditionally," he told the gathering.
rows.reference: "They must withdraw immediately and without any conditions," he told the assembly.

rows.source: Moualem ya dage cewa “yaki da ta’addanci ya kusan karewa” a Sham, wurin da fiye da mutane 360,000 suka rasa rayuwar su tun 2011, tare da rashin gidajen miliyoyin mutane.
rows.output: Moualem insisted that "the fight against terrorism is almost over" in Sham, where more than 360,000 people have lost their lives since 2011, with millions of people displaced.
rows.reference: Moualem insisted that the "war on terror is almost over" in Syria, where more than 360,000 people have died since 2011, with millions more uprooted from their homes.

rows.source: ya ce Damascus zata ci gaba da “yakin nan mai sarki har sai an tsarkake dukka yankunan Sham” na duk kungiyoyin ta’addanci da “duk wani jami’i da ke nan ba tare da izini ba.”
rows.output: He said that Damascus would continue to be "at war with the king of kings until all the regions of Sham are cleansed of all the sects and any agent who is here without permission."
rows.reference: He said Damascus would continue "fighting this sacred battle until we purge all Syrian territories" of both terror groups and "any illegal foreign presence."

rows.source: Amurka tana da wasu sojoji 2,000 a Sham, akasarinsu su na ba da horo da shawara wa sojojin Kurdawa da Larabawan Sham da basa son Shugaban kasar Bashar al-Assad.
rows.output: The United States has 2,000 troops in Syria, most of them are training and advising the Syrian Kurds and Arab forces who do not want President Bashar al-Assad.
rows.reference: The United States has some 2,000 troops in Syria, mainly training and advising both Kurdish forces and Syrian Arabs opposed to President Bashar al-Assad.

rows.source: Faransa tana da fiye da sojoji 1,000 a kasar da ke fama da yakin.
rows.output: France has more than 1,000 soldiers in a country plagued by war.
rows.reference: France has more than 1,000 troops on the ground in the war-wracked country.

rows.source: Akan batun yan gudun hijira, Moualem ya ce yanayin sun gyaru masu su dawo, kuma ya zargi “wasu ƙasashen yammaci” da “yada tsoro mara kyau” da yasa masu gudun hijira suka ƙi dawowa.
rows.output: On the issue of refugees, Moualem said that the situation has improved for them to return, and he accused "some Western countries" of "spreading false fears" that have deterred refugees from returning.
rows.reference: On the issue of refugees, Moualem said the conditions were fine for them to return, and he blamed "some western countries" for "spreading irrational fears" that prompted refugees to stay away.

rows.source: “Mun yi kira ga kasashen duniya da kungiyoyin agaji su sauƙaƙe da dawowar su,” ya ce.
rows.output: “We have called on the international community and humanitarian organizations to facilitate their return,” he said.
rows.reference: "We have called upon the international community and humanitarian organizations to facilitate these returns," he said.

rows.source: “Su na siyasance abun da zallan batun jin kai ne.”
rows.output: They are politically sensitive to the issue of humanitarian aid.
rows.reference: "They are politicizing what should be a purely humanitarian issue."

rows.source: Amurka da Kungiyar Turai sun ba da gargadi cewa ba za’a bayar da agajin sake gine-ginen Sham ba har sai an samu yarjejeniya tsakanin Assad da ‘yan adawa ga yakin.
rows.output: The United States and the European Union have warned that no reconstruction aid will be given to Syria unless an agreement is reached between Assad and the opposition.
rows.reference: The United States and the European Union have warned that there will be no reconstruction aid for Syria until there is a political agreement between Assad and the opposition to end the war.

rows.source: ma’aikatan hulɗa na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya sun ce wani yarjejeniya na kwanan nan tsakanin Rasha da Turkiya dan kebe tudun mun tsira a babban yankin karshe da ‘yan adawa suke rike da shi a Idlib ya samar da daman ci gaba da maganganun siyasa.
rows.output: The UN Security Council's peacekeeping mission said a recent agreement between Russia and Turkey to keep the ceasefire in the last major rebel-held area in Idlib has opened up the possibility of a political solution.
rows.reference: UN diplomats say a recent agreement between Russia and Turkey to set up a buffer zone in the last major rebel stronghold of Idlib has created an opportunity to press ahead with political talks.

rows.source: Yarjejeniyar Rasha da Turkiyar ya kawar da babban hari da ‘yan Sham masu goyon bayan Rasha suka kai lardin, wurin da mutane miliyan uku suke zama.
rows.output: The agreement between Russia and Turkey has removed the major threat of Russian-backed Syrian forces on the region, where three million people live.
rows.reference: The Russian-Turkish deal averted a large-scale assault by Russian-backed Syrian forces on the province, where three million people live.

rows.source: Moualem duk da haka ya jadadda cewa yarjejeniyar ta na da “bayyanannen kwanaki” kuma sun bayyana sa rai cewa aikin sojoji zai mayar da hankali ga ‘yan ta’adda ne tare da mafaɗa daga Nusra Front masu alaka da Al-Qaeda, waɗanda “za’a magance.”
rows.output: Moualem, however, insisted that the agreement was "clearly worded" and expressed confidence that the military operation would focus on "terrorist groups" including the Al-Qaeda-linked Nusra Front, which "would be addressed."
rows.reference: Moualem however stressed that the agreement had "clear deadlines" and expressed hope that military action will target jihadists including fighters from the Al-Qaeda-linked Nusra Front, who "will be eradicated."

rows.source: Wakilin Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya Staffan de Mistura yana sa ran cikin kwanan nan zai kira taron farko na kwamitin wanda ke kunsheda mambobin gwamnati da na ‘yan adawa su rubuta tsarin mulkin kasa bayan yaki na Sham ya kuma buɗe hanyar zabe.
rows.output: The UN Special Adviser Staffan de Mistura is hopeful that in the coming days he will convene the first meeting of the committee that includes members of the government and the opposition to draft a national reconciliation plan after the war in Syria and to open the way for elections.
rows.reference: UN envoy Staffan de Mistura is hoping to soon convene the first meetings of a new committee comprised of government and opposition members to draft a post-war constitution for Syria and pave the way to elections.

rows.source: Moualem ya fitar da sharruɗan da zasu sa gwamnatin Sham ta shiga cikin kwamitin, yana cewa a kuntata aikin bangarorin “zuwa yin bitar dokokin wannan tsarin mulkin na yau,” kuma yana bada gargaɗin tsangwama.
rows.output: Moualem presented the candidates who would make the government of Sham enter the committee, saying that the work of the parties "would be to review the laws of this current system of government," and warned of a boycott.
rows.reference: Moualem laid out conditions for the Syrian government's participation in the committee, saying the panel's work should be restricted "to reviewing the articles of the current constitution," and warned against interference.

rows.source: Abun Da Ya Sa Trump Zai Sake Cin Zabe Karo na Biyu
rows.output: What Made Trump Decide to Run for a Second Term

rows.source: Bisa ga wannan dabarar, Mr. Trump zai sake cin zabe karo na biu a 2020 sai dai idan, yadda mambobin jam’iyyar ‘yanci da yawa suke sa rai, tsiguwa da abubuwan kunya sun kawo karshen shugabancin shi kafin lokacin sa.
rows.output: Based on this strategy, Mr. Trump will win the election again in 2020 unless, as many members of the Republican Party are now beginning to realize, the scandals and embarrassments that have plagued his presidency bring it to an end before its time.
rows.reference: By that logic, Mr. Trump would win re-election in 2020 unless, as many liberal viewers are probably hoping, impeachment and scandal end his presidency prematurely.

rows.source: A abun da ba ko gardama zai zama “mafi ban mamakin karshen shugabanci har abada!”

rows.source: A halin yanzu, babu wani alamar gajiyar mai kallo.

rows.output: As of 2014, Nielsen's primary time ratings were up more than 100% from the previous year to 1.05 million at CNN and nearly 50% to 1.6 million at MSNBC.
rows.reference: Since 2014, prime-time ratings have more than doubled to 1.05 million at CNN and nearly tripled to 1.6 million at MSNBC.

rows.source: Fox News su na da matsakaicin masu kallon firayim lokaci miliyan 2.4, sama daga miliyan 1.7 shekaru huɗu da suka wuce, a cewar Nielsen, da “Wasar Rachel Maddow” na MSNBC ya yi rinjayen kididdigar kebur da masu kallo har zuwa miliyan 3.5 a daren manyan labarai.
rows.output: Fox News had an average of 2.4 million viewers during the first quarter, up from 1.7 million four years ago, according to Nielsen, while MSNBC's "The Rachel Maddow Show" had a record 3.5 million viewers in the evening news.
rows.reference: Fox News has an average of 2.4 million prime-time viewers, up from 1.7 million four years ago, according to Nielsen, and MSNBC's "The Rachel Maddow Show" has topped cable ratings with as many as 3.5 million viewers on major news nights.

rows.source: “Wannan wuta ne da ake jawo mutane zuwa saboda ba abu ne da muke ganewa ba,” inji Neal Baer, mai gudanar da wasan kwaikwayon ABC “Designated Survivor”, akan sakataren majalisa da ya zama shugaban kasa bayan an kai hari da ya hallaka Capitol.
rows.output: “This is a fire that we are bringing to the people because it is not something that we are seeing,” said Neal Baer, the executive producer of the ABC show “Designated Survivor,” about the secretary of the House who became president after an attack that killed everyone in the Capitol.
rows.reference: "This is a fire that people are being drawn to because it's not something we understand," said Neal Baer, show runner of the ABC drama "Designated Survivor," about a cabinet secretary who becomes president after an attack destroys the Capitol.

rows.source: kuma a hakan, ya wuce zama ɗan kasa sananne idan ka ga kan ka a awa shida na kallon kwamitin gwanaye su na tattauna amfani da “bayanai masu zurfi” na Bob Woodward yana nemar ma littafin shi “Tsoro,” Jaket ɗin fata mai zanen jimina na Paul Manafort mai farashin dala 15,000 (“wani kaya mai kauri da kima,” Washington post sun ce) da kuma muhimmancin tsatsan bayanin, um, jikin Mr Trump da Stormy Daniel ya yi.
rows.output: And on that, it went beyond being a known citizen when you see yourself at six o'clock in the evening watching the committee of the electors discuss the use of "deep background" information from Bob Woodward seeking out his book "Fear," the $15,000 fur coat with the embroidered lining of Paul Manafort ("a valuable and durable item," the Washington Post said) and the importance of the detailed explanation, um, of Mr. Trump's body and Stormy Daniels' body.
rows.reference: And yet, it goes beyond being an informed citizen when you find yourself on hour six of watching a panel of experts debate Bob Woodward's use of "deep background" sourcing for his book "Fear," Paul Manafort's $15,000 ostrich-leather bomber jacket ("a garment thick with hubris," The Washington Post said) and the implications of Stormy Daniels's lurid descriptions of Mr. Trump's, um, anatomy.

rows.reference: "Part of what he's doing that makes it feel like a reality show is that he is feeding you something every night," said Brent Montgomery, chief executive of Wheelhouse Entertainment and the creator of "Pawn Stars," about the Trump show's rotating cast and daily plot twists (picking a fight with the N.F.L., praising Kim Jong-un).

rows.source: Ba abun mamaki bane cewa 17 na Pennsylvania yana ganin kuɗi masu yawa, godiya ga sake daidaituwar gundumar majalisa da ya kawo ga masu sarauta biyu a gasar kujera ɗaya.
rows.output: It is not surprising that 17th Pennsylvania sees a lot of money, thanks to the redistricting of the House of Representatives that brought two incumbents into the same seat race.
rows.reference: It's not surprising that Pennsylvania's 17th is seeing a flood of cash, thanks to a realignment of a congressional districts that landed two incumbents in a race for the same seat.

rows.source: Wannan sabon tsarin yankunan wajen Pittsburg ya haɗda Ɗan Majalisar Jam’iyyar Damokraɗiya Conor Lamb - wanda ya ci kujerar a wata gundumar a wani zaben musamman bazarar da ta wuce.
rows.output: This new map of the western Pennsylvania congressional districts combines Democratic Rep. Conor Lamb - who won a special election in a district redrawn after the last census - with another Democratic seat.
rows.reference: This recently redrawn suburban Pittsburg district pits Democrat Rep. Conor Lamb - who won his seat in another district in a special election last spring.

rows.source: Lamb yana takarar tare da wani Ɗan Majalisa, Ɗan jam’iyar Republican Keith Rothfus, wanda ke wakiltar tsohon Gundumar Pennsylvania na 12, wanda ya haɗda sosai da sabon na 17.
rows.output: Lamb is running with another Republican Congressman, Keith Rothfus, who represents the former 12th District of Pennsylvania, which is largely included in the new 17th District.
rows.reference: Lamb is running against another incumbent, Republican Keith Rothfus, who currently represents the old Pennsylvania 12th district, which overlaps heavily with the new 17th.

rows.source: An sake zane taswirar ne bayan Babban Kotun Pennsylvania ta yanken hukunci a Janairu cewa an haɗe iyakan tsofaffin gundumomin na ba akan shari’a ba dan a yima jam’iyar Republicans ni’ima.
rows.output: The map was redrawn after the Pennsylvania Supreme Court ruled in January that the boundaries of the old city's wards were not drawn on the basis of population, but rather to favor Republicans.
rows.reference: The maps were redrawn after the Pennsylvania Supreme Court ruled in January that the old districts were unconstitutionally gerrymandered in Republicans' favor.

rows.source: Takarar a sabon na 17 ɗin ya buɗe hanyar gasar kuɗi tsakanin saasan kuɗaɗen manyan jam’iyu, Kwamitin Yakin Zaben Majalisa na Damokraɗiya (DCCC) da Kwamitin Yakin Zaben na Kasa na Republicans (NRCC).
rows.output: The race in the new 17th district opened up a competition for funds between party campaign committees, the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee (DCCC) and the National Republican Congressional Committee (NRCC).
rows.reference: The race in the new 17th has touched off a campaign finance slugfest between the major party finance arms, the Democratic Campaign Congressional Committee (DCCC) and the National Republican Campaign Committee (NRCC).

rows.source: Lamb ya zama sanannen suna a Pennsylvania bayan matsatten nasara a wani zaben mussamman da aka kalla sosai a Maris na Majalisar 18 na Gundumar Pennsylvania.
rows.output: Lamb became a well-known name in Pennsylvania after a landslide victory in a closely watched special election in March of the 18th Congressional District of Pennsylvania.
rows.reference: Lamb became a familiar name in Pennsylvania after a narrow win in a widely watched in March special election for Pennsylvania's 18th Congressional District.

rows.source: Wannan kujerar da tana hannun Republican ne fiye da shekaru goma, kuma shugaban kasa Donald Trump ya ci gundumar da maki 20.

rows.reference: That seat had been held by a Republican for over a decade, and President Donald Trump won the district by 20 points.

rows.output: Mr. Trump held a meeting with President Juan Carlos Varela of Panama in June 2017 and had a hotel in Panama until his business associates were forced to terminate the management contract of the Trump Organization.
rows.reference: Mr. Trump had a warm meeting with President Juan Carlos Varela of Panama in June 2017 and had a hotel in Panama until partners evicted the Trump Organization's management team.

rows.output: The State Department has decided to recall senior officials from the US diplomatic missions in El Salvador, the Dominican Republic, and Panama on this "recently imposed visa ban on Taiwan," said Heather Nauert, the State Department's spokesperson, in a statement earlier this month.
rows.reference: State Department officials decided to call back the American chiefs of diplomatic missions from El Salvador, the Dominican Republic and Panama over the "recent decisions to no longer recognize Taiwan," Heather Nauert, the department's spokeswoman, said in a statement early this month.

rows.output: But only nine have been studied in El Salvador, which received about $140 million in aid from the US in 2017, including drug addiction treatment and economic support.

rows.source: Ga wasu manyan girgizar ƙasa da tsunami a cikin 'yan shekarun nan:

rows.source: 2004: Babban girgizar kasa a yammacin tekun Aceh dake arewacin Sumatra a ranar 26 ga Disamban bara ya haifar da tsunami wanda ya shafi kasashe 14, inda ya kashe mutane 226,000 a bakin tekun Indiya, fiye da rabin su a Aceh.
rows.output: 2004: A major earthquake in the western coast of Aceh, Indonesia, on December 26, 2004, triggered a tsunami that affected 14 countries, killing 226,000 people along the Indian Ocean coast, with more than half of the deaths in Aceh.
rows.reference: 2004: A major quake on the western coast of Indonesia's Aceh province in northern Sumatra on Dec. 26 triggered a tsunami that struck 14 countries, killing 226,000 people along Indian Ocean coastline, more than half of them in Aceh.

rows.output: 2005: A series of earthquakes occurred in the western part of Sumatra Island in late March and early April.
rows.reference: 2005: A series of strong quakes hit the western coast of Sumatra in late March and early April.

rows.source: Daruruwa sun mutu a tsibirin Nias, a bakin tekun Sumatra.

rows.output: 2006: An earthquake of magnitude 6.8 occurred in southern Java, the most populous island in Indonesia, triggering a tsunami that affected the entire southern coast, resulting in the deaths of approximately 700 people.
rows.reference: 2006: A 6.8 magnitude hit south of Java, Indonesia's most populated island, triggering a tsunami that smashed into the southern coast, killing nearly 700 people.

rows.source: Fiye da mutane 1,100 aka kashe.

rows.source: Ana kuma tuhuma shi da wani mummunan lakabi na Ajin B, wanda hukunci shi ne ya je kurkuku na rana guda da kuma tarar $2,000.
rows.output: He is also charged with a Class B misdemeanor, which carries a penalty of one day in jail and a $2,000 fine.
rows.reference: He has also been charged with a Class B misdemeanour, punishable by a day in jail and a $2,000 fine.

rows.source: Ba shi ne karo na farko da aka gurfanar da Palin ba akan mayan laifuka.
rows.output: It is not the first time that Palin has been charged with election fraud.

rows.source: Masu gabatar da kara na tarayya na neman hukuncin kisa na kisa ga dan ta’adda NYC
rows.output: The federal prosecutors are seeking the death penalty for the NYC bomber.

rows.source: Masu gabatar da kara na tarayya a birnin New York suna neman hukuncin kisa ga Sayfullo Saipov, wanda ake zargin a harin da ya faru a birnin New York, wanda ya kashe mutane takwas - hukuncin da ba a yi ba a jihar don aikata laifukan tarayya tun shekara ta 1953.
rows.output: Federal prosecutors in New York are seeking the death penalty for Sayfullo Saipov, who is accused of the 2017 New York City attack that killed eight people - a punishment not previously available in the state for federal crimes since 1953.
rows.reference: Federal prosecutors in New York are seeking the death penalty for Sayfullo Saipov, the suspect in the New York City terror attack that killed eight people -- a rare punishment that hasn't been carried out in the state for a federal crime since 1953.

rows.source: Saipov, mai shekaru 30, ya yi amfani da motoci mai hawa na gida domin gudanar da hare-haren kan hanyar machine da ta hanyar West Side Highway a Lower Manhattan, inda ya kaddamar akan masu tafiya a kafa da kekuna a hanyarsa a watan Oktoba.
rows.output: Saipov, 30, used a rental truck to carry out the attack on a bike path along the West Side Highway in Lower Manhattan, where he struck pedestrians and cyclists in his path in October.
rows.reference: Saipov, 30, allegedly used a Home Depot rental truck to carry out an attack on a bike path along the West Side Highway in Lower Manhattan, mowing down pedestrians and cyclist in his path on Oct.

rows.source: Don tabbatar da hukuncin kisa, masu gabatar da kara za su tabbatar da cewa Saipov "da gangan" ya kashe mutane takwas da "ganganci" ya jawo mummunan rauni a jiki, bisa ga sanarwar na neman hukuncin kisa, aka a yankin Kudancin Sabon Gundumar New York.
rows.output: To confirm the death sentence, the prosecution will prove that Saipov "intentionally" killed eight people and "knowingly" caused severe physical injury to others, according to the notice of the death sentence, filed in the Southern District of New York.
rows.reference: In order to justify a death sentence, prosecutors will have to prove that Saipov "intentionally" killed the eight victims and "intentionally" inflicted serious bodily injury, according to the notice of intent to seek the death penalty, filed in the Southern District of New York.

rows.source: Dukkan waɗanda nan la'akari su na da hukuncin kisa, bisa ga takardun kotu.
rows.output: All those who are considered to be sentenced to death, according to court documents.
rows.reference: Both of those counts carry a possibly death sentence, according to the court document.

rows.source: Makonni bayan harin, babban kotun tarayya ta maka wa Saipov zarge-zarge 22 da suka hada da laifuffuka guda takwas na kisan kai don taimakon rashin gaskiya, yawanci sune masu gabatar da kara ke yi a laifukan shiryeyyen laifi, da kuma cajin tashin hankali da halakar da motoci.
rows.output: A few weeks after the attack, the US District Court in Manhattan charged Saipov with 22 counts, including eight counts of terrorism for providing material support to ISIS, and other charges of destruction of vehicles and property.
rows.reference: Weeks after the attack, a federal grand jury slapped Saipov with a 22-count indictment that included eight charges of murder in aid of racketeering, typically used by federal prosecutors in organized crime cases, and a charge of violence and destruction of motor vehicles.

rows.source: Wannan harin ya bukaci "tsarawa mai mahimmanci da kaddamarwa," in ji masu gabatar da kara, inda ya bayyana irin yadda Saipov ya dauki shi a matsayin "mai mugunta, mummunan hali da kuma marar sa tausayi."
rows.output: This attack required "significant planning and execution," the prosecutors said, describing how Saipov carried it out as "a depraved, evil act and a cowardly act."
rows.reference: The attack required "substantial planning and premeditation," prosecutors said, describing the manner in which Saipov carried it out as "heinous, cruel and depraved."

rows.source: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov ya haifar da rauni, cuta, da hasara ga iyalai da abokai Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, da Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," sanarwa na niyyar jihohi.
rows.output: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov ya haifar da rauni, cuta, da hasara ga iyalai da abokai Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, da Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," a cikin sanarwar da hukumar ta fitar.
rows.reference: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov caused injury, harm, and loss to the families and friends of Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, and Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," the notice of intent states.

rows.source: Biyar daga cikin waɗanda aka kashe 'yan yawon bude ido daga Argentina
rows.output: Four of the victims were tourists from Argentina
